# Karigari

Karigari converts handwritten notes, worksheets, equations, and study pages into editable, searchable text.

## Important pages

- Homepage: https://www.cleanote.in/
- Handwriting to text: https://www.cleanote.in/handwriting-to-text/
- Homework scanner: https://www.cleanote.in/homework-scanner/
- Web scanner: https://www.cleanote.in/app/
- Support: https://www.cleanote.in/support/
- Privacy: https://www.cleanote.in/privacy/

## Product notes

Karigari is operated by Karigari Home LLC. It is designed for students, parents, researchers, and professionals who need to capture handwritten or annotated paper material and review converted text before using it. Cleanote refers only to the company's physical writing tablet and Slate products.
